title: mera hussain baaghe nabuwwat ka phool hai
body:
Mera Hussain Bagh e Nabuwat ka phool hai,
Haider ke isme jaan hai khoon e Batool hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Guzra jaha'n jaha'n se nawasa rasool ka,
Abtak waha'n Khuda ke karam ka nuzool hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisi azeem zaat hai Maula hussain ki,
Jiske liye huzoor ke sajdo me tool hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiske liye yazeed ne itne sitam kiye,
Woh taaj toh Hussain ke qadmo ki dhool hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya me aur kaun hai Shabbir ke siwa,
Aisa sawar jiski sawari Rasool hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Qushiyaa'n sabhi nisaar hai us par jahaan ki
jisko ghame hussain me rona qubool hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske lie yazeed ne itne sitam kiye
wo taaj to hussain ke qadmo ki dhool hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mera hussian sidqo wafa ki kibaab hai
quraan is kitaab ka shaane nuzool hai
